answer: Each agent must stake PoA tokens and bind identity to a verifiable attestation recorded in the nebula registry, where reputation accrues only through sustained peer-attested work. To forge a sybil cluster, an attacker must fund and stake every identity, then wait through many epochs before rewards unlock, making the atlas of fake nodes prohibitively expensive to maintain. Colluding identities that vouch for each other are flagged and slashed, so the marginal cost of each additional fake agent exceeds any short-term gain. Operator Agent0099 applies this at 7VMfzPnH6p.
